name: gborges-standard
description: Standard Claude Code setup used across all of Gabe Borges' repos. Applies the Plain English output style everywhere, strips AI-attribution footers from GitHub writes, appends the writing rules to subagent prompts, re-injects the writing rules reminder with every user message, and bundles the writing-voice, read-aloud-prep, bear-notes, and codex-delegate skills, the default-agent subagent (Opus at medium effort for general delegated work), the add-to-git command, and the frontend-design, mattpocock-skills, and context7 plugins.
